description: This file defines a PHP class `FormatWithDateTime` implementing the `ValueFormatter` interface, providing functionality to format DateTime objects into a specific string format.

classes.name: FormatWithDateTime
classes.description: A formatter class that converts DateTime objects into a standardized string format ('Y-m-d H:i:s').

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string 'Y-m-d H:i:s', returns null if the input is not a DateTime instance.
